title: Archive suggest (fleet / one repo)
description: Written archive plan for quiet repos. Dry-run only — never archives on GitHub.
goalTemplate:
Propose archive / keep / continue for repositories {{repositories}}. Scope: {{scope}}.

1) Prefer `ncc ai workflow fleet --json` or `lifecycle --workspace <id> --json`.
2) For each archive-candidate: why, risk, GitHub archive steps (manual), whether to remove from NCC workspaces.
3) For later/once: keep vs resume suggestions.
4) Never call gh api to archive. Never delete. Dry-run report only.
